Baked Sweet and Spicy Peppers
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, March 18, 2014 - 1:43pm

Ingredients




3 bell peppers
3 long hot peppers
4 cloves of garlic – chopped
½ tsp. salt
1 tsp. dried oregano
¼ tsp. black pepper
3 tablespoons olive oil

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 Place the peppers whole on a baking pan. 3 Bake until the peppers are soft; about 20-25 minutes. 4 Let the peppers cool.   Remove the stems and slice the peppers. 5 Place in a bowl with the garlic, oil and seasonings.
